summary: The Python SDK's bundled quinn-proto v0.11.12 dependency contains CVE-2026-31812, a vulnerability allowing unauthenticated remote DoS via panic in QUIC transport parameter parsing. Updating to quinn-proto >= 0.11.14 resolves the issue.
userImpact: Python SDK applications are vulnerable to unauthenticated remote DoS attacks through the Rust bridge's QUIC transport parameter parsing.
rootCause: quinn-proto v0.11.12 contains a panic vulnerability in QUIC transport parameter parsing that can be triggered remotely without authentication.
proposedFix: Update quinn-proto dependency from v0.11.12 to >= v0.11.14
resolutionDetails: Resolved by updating quinn-proto to version >= 0.11.14 via PR #1357
keyQuote: Updating quinn-proto to >= 0.11.14 resolves the CVE.
